# Best noise-cancelling earbuds under $150

I only have a direct purchase link for the Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro. For the others, I've linked the review page where I found the price.

## My picks

**Best overall value: Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro, $149.99 (about $120 with a code)**
- It has adaptive ANC, LDAC, multipoint and a wireless-charging case. SoundGuys rated it 8.2/10, and iTech Level calls it the best value ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)).
- A deal site reports that code AFSC20 took $29.99 off at Soundcore's US store when tested on 2026-10-22. The code expires 2026-12-31 and doesn't work on items already on sale. Checkout has the final say.
- Caveat: it's the previous generation, and the newer Liberty 5 Pro costs $169.99. Battery with ANC is about 5.7 to 7.5 hours.
- [Buy at Soundcore](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-liberty-4-pro). This is an affiliate link, so the site earns a commission at no cost to you. Source: [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/soundcore-liberty-4-pro).

**Best ANC for Android: Nothing Ear (3), just under $150 on Amazon**
- SoundGuys scored its ANC 8.2/10. It has LDAC, multipoint and wireless charging.
- Downsides: the sound is bass-heavy, the mics are muffled, and ANC battery life is only about 5 hours ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/), [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)).

**Best for Samsung: Galaxy Buds3 Pro, about $134 on Amazon from Samsung's official store**
- SlashGear praises the ANC and rates them IPX7. They work on most Android phones, but they're built for Samsung ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)).

**Best for iPhone: AirPods Pro 2 (renewed), just under $150 on sale**
- SlashGear's reviewer calls the ANC and transparency mode excellent. Apple no longer sells them new, so you'll be buying renewed or from other retailers ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)).
- The newer AirPods 5 ($129) have an open fit, so they block less noise ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)).

**Best Sony option: WF-C710N, $119 at Walmart or $128 at Best Buy**
- What Hi-Fi? names it best budget. It has about 8.5 hours of battery with ANC but no LDAC ([What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-the-true-wireless-way-to-cut-out-background-noise), [Sound Mavericks](https://soundmavericks.com/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-under-150/)).

**Cheapest decent option: Soundcore P31i, $59.99**
- It has adaptive ANC, multipoint and IP55 rating. The ANC is weaker than the pricier picks, but it's fine for steady noise like planes and cars ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)).

## Quick advice
- **Android:** Liberty 4 Pro or Nothing Ear (3).
- **iPhone:** AirPods Pro 2 (renewed).
- **Tightest budget:** Soundcore P31i.
- **Want the very best ANC?** The Bose QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds (2nd Gen) cost $299, well over your limit ([Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/audio/earbuds/best-noise-canceling-earbuds)).

Prices change often, so confirm at checkout.
